title: How to Build an Offer People Actually Want
description: A good product is not enough when the buying journey is confusing. This episode shows how entry points, friction, proof, urgency, and a coherent path make an offer easier to buy.
cta: Next, we test whether marketing is really the problem — or whether the product needs fixing first.
alternativeTitles: Your Product May Be Good — Your Offer Is Hard to Buy

shortA.title: A Good Product Can Still Be Hard to Buy
shortA.alternateHook: Every unnecessary step gives an interested customer another reason to postpone.

shortB.title: The 30-Second Offer Test
shortB.alternateHook: Can a new visitor understand the offer, price path, and next step in thirty seconds?
